description: Web data infrastructure platform providing proxy networks, web scraping APIs, unblocking solutions, and remote browsers for developers and AI agents.
auth_notes: API access uses Bearer tokens (API keys) in HTTP headers or via SDK/CLI; proxy and native access use basic-style username and password formats.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account/trial and generate API keys or access tokens self-serve through the dashboard control panel.
api_notes: Covers web scraping APIs, Web Unlocker, SERP APIs, Scraping Browser automation, dataset marketplaces, proxy management, and an official MCP server.
mcp_notes: Bright Data publishes an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents to query web data and execute actions.
rationale: Bright Data provides extensive public REST APIs, official SDKs/CLI, an official MCP server, and self-serve developer account access.

evidence.note: Details Bearer token API key authentication headers and SDK initialization parameters.
Explains self-serve account sign-up and control panel API key generation.
Lists products including Web Access APIs, Scraper APIs, Browser APIs, and the Bright Data MCP server.
